title: Vegetarian Aji Pasta
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegetarian pasta dish featuring the heat of aji peppers. This recipe is quick, easy, and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced aji peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Stir in the umami sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce is heated through.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the sauce until the pasta is well coated.
Stir in the chopped ac crunchy and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot topped with shaved parmesan cheese.
Optional: add some grated aji pepper on top for extra heat.
